decisions.question: Which teachers, tasks, phases, and matched-primary inclusion rule define the population?

viable_options.tradeoff: More likely to reach 15 matched units, but adds training and a phase-availability selection layer.

viable_options.tradeoff: Cheapest but does not repair the red-team population limitation.

recommendation.pair_rule: for each seed 0-14, each primary phase, and each hard/soft condition, source is the direct teacher and recipient is the lowest fixed initialization slot that is eligible; if none is eligible the pair is unavailable and is not replaced
recommendation.representation: unitary 2-D discrete Fourier transform over the ordered modular input grid, complex coefficients represented as ordered real/imaginary pairs
recommendation.mode_rule: fixed algebraic mode list reduced modulo task modulus; no activation or outcome ranking
recommendation.location: final-token residual stream at blocks.{last_layer}.hook_resid_post before unembedding
recommendation.alignment: orthogonal Procrustes fit in float64 on the fixed training-domain split only, with sign/SVD tie convention and no trial-outcome inputs
recommendation.fitting_boundary: canonical training split; evaluation and outcome inputs are disjoint test split

recommendation.trial_inputs: 256 canonically spaced test inputs per pair; no replacement when the eligible test set is smaller
recommendation.outcome: change from intact recipient in correct-class centered-logit margin, with accuracy and nonfinite/censoring diagnostics retained
recommendation.aggregation: within comparison set, aligned minus each control; then teacher-seed paired mean separately by phase and condition
recommendation.success_rule: shared-abstraction claim eligible only when every aligned-minus-control teacher-seed 95% bootstrap interval has lower bound greater than zero and every comparison inventory is complete; otherwise not_met, indeterminate, or unavailable

decisions.amendment_consequence: Any pair, mode, location, alignment, capacity, outcome, or success-rule change after approval is a scientific amendment requiring new trial and report hashes.

package_alternatives.summary: Recommended package above: 15 fixed teachers, strict three-of-six Tier 1 students, five-family sparse architecture panel, full required basis/null/Fourier repairs, and conservative orchestration.
Uses the B option for RD-003 and RD-007 and a two-alternate architecture panel; lower cost but materially weaker realization, architecture, and search coverage.
Uses seeds 0-19 with first-15-complete selection and Package A elsewhere; more teacher compute and a more complex phase-availability selection rule.
